entries.en: The office faxed the signed contract to the supplier before lunch.
entries.zh: 办公室在午饭前把签好的合同传真给了供应商。

entries.zh: 帕特尔医生放下听诊器后，才回答病人的问题。

entries.zh: 冶金学家比较了这两份合金样品的钴含量。

entries.en: They found traces of DNA on the envelope but could not identify its sender.
entries.zh: 他们在信封上发现了微量脱氧核糖核酸，却无法确定寄信人。

entries.meaningZh: 英国国家医疗服务体系
entries.en: She works for the NHS and cycles to the hospital each morning.
entries.zh: 她在英国国家医疗服务体系工作，每天早上骑车去医院。

entries.en: We watched the documentary on ITV after dinner.
entries.zh: 晚饭后，我们在英国独立电视台看了那部纪录片。

entries.en: The factory strengthened QC after several faulty switches reached customers.
entries.zh: 几只故障开关流到客户手中后，工厂加强了质量控制。

entries.en: The patrol returned to the OP before nightfall.
entries.zh: 巡逻队在天黑前回到了观察哨。

entries.en: The GM postponed the meeting until the accounts were ready.
entries.zh: 总经理把会议推迟到财务报表准备好之后。

entries.en: The RC failed, so the model boat drifted towards the bank.
entries.zh: 遥控系统失灵了，因此模型船向岸边漂去。

entries.en: The chemist separated HON from the other amino acids in the sample.
entries.zh: 化学家将样品中的 δ-羟基-γ-氧代正缬氨酸与其他氨基酸分离开来。

entries.en: The team extracted RNA from the leaf tissue.
entries.zh: 研究团队从叶片组织中提取了核糖核酸。

entries.en: He prefers DIY to hiring someone for small repairs.
entries.zh: 做小修小补时，他宁愿自己动手，也不愿雇人。

entries.en: She compared Fr with neighbouring elements in her chemistry essay.
entries.zh: 她在化学论文中比较了钫与相邻元素。

entries.en: The MC introduced the next speaker and checked the microphone.
entries.zh: 司仪介绍了下一位发言者，并检查了麦克风。

entries.en: She packed a few travel mags for the train journey.
entries.zh: 她为这趟火车旅行带上了几本旅游杂志。

entries.en: The RPM fell as the motor slowed.
entries.zh: 随着电动机减速，每分钟转数下降了。

entries.meaningZh: 需家长指导观看的；可能有不适合儿童内容的（电影分级）
entries.en: We chose a PG film for the family evening.
entries.zh: 我们为家庭晚间活动选了一部需家长指导观看的电影。

entries.en: They compared two estimates of the MEP for the same reaction.
entries.zh: 他们比较了对同一反应的最低能量途径所作的两种估计。

entries.en: The membrane fraction contained more PE than the comparison sample.
entries.zh: 该膜组分所含的磷脂酰乙醇胺比对照样品更多。

entries.en: Er was detected in the mineral recovered from the old mine.
entries.zh: 从旧矿井取得的矿物中检测到了铒。

entries.en: The second reaction gave a higher de without increasing the overall yield.
entries.zh: 第二个反应的非对映体过量更高，但总产率没有提高。

entries.en: She joined IBM after completing her engineering degree.
entries.zh: 她完成工程学学位后加入了国际商用机器公司。

entries.meaningZh: 数字设备公司（历史计算机公司）
entries.en: The laboratory bought a used computer from DEC.
entries.zh: 实验室从数字设备公司买了一台二手计算机。

entries.en: The BBC broadcast the interview after the evening news.
entries.zh: 英国广播公司在晚间新闻后播出了那段采访。

entries.en: The mineral contained La as well as several other elements.
entries.zh: 这块矿物含有镧及其他几种元素。

entries.en: The soil sample contained Ca, although its concentration was not reported.
entries.zh: 土壤样品含有钙，但未说明其浓度。

entries.en: The FA reviewed the referee's report before announcing its decision.
entries.zh: 英格兰足球协会在宣布决定前审阅了裁判的报告。

entries.en: The fragments differed in length by several bp.
entries.zh: 这些片段的长度相差几个碱基对。

entries.en: The new analysis found Li in the brine sample.
entries.zh: 新的分析在卤水样品中发现了锂。

entries.en: Meg left her umbrella beside the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 梅格把伞放在了厨房门旁。

entries.en: The museum displayed an early computer built by ICL.

entries.en: The mutation replaced Val with another amino acid in the protein.
entries.zh: 这次突变使蛋白质中的缬氨酸被另一种氨基酸替代。

entries.en: Noise distorted the PAM signal before it reached the receiver.
entries.zh: 脉冲幅度调制信号到达接收器之前，受噪声影响而失真。

entries.en: The source of the Ni found in the alloy was still uncertain.
entries.zh: 在合金中发现的镍，其来源仍不确定。

entries.meaningZh: 播放唱片音乐的主持人；唱片骑师

entries.zh: 发布通知时，唱片骑师调低了音乐音量。

entries.en: The updated docs explain how to restart the server.
entries.zh: 更新后的文档说明了如何重启服务器。

entries.en: The batch file used DEL to remove the temporary copies.
entries.zh: 该批处理文件用删除文件命令清除了临时副本。

entries.en: The administrator checked the SID before changing the account permissions.
entries.zh: 管理员在更改账户权限前检查了安全标识符。

entries.en: The CBI invited local manufacturers to discuss the proposed changes.
entries.zh: 英国工业联合会邀请当地制造商讨论拟议的变动。

entries.en: The engineer traced the EMI to a nearby power supply.
entries.zh: 工程师查明，电磁干扰来自附近的一个电源。

entries.en: She used SQL to retrieve the orders placed during the holiday.
entries.zh: 她使用结构化查询语言检索了假日期间下的订单。

entries.en: The repair shop ordered a replacement fan directly from the OEM.
entries.zh: 维修店直接向原始设备制造商订购了一个替换风扇。

entries.en: The WC at the end of the corridor was occupied.
entries.zh: 走廊尽头的厕所正有人使用。

entries.en: The technician used FC to compare the two saved files.
entries.zh: 技术员用文件比较命令比较了那两个已保存的文件。

entries.en: The team compared MAO activity in the two tissue samples.
entries.zh: 研究团队比较了这两份组织样品中的单胺氧化酶活性。

entries.zh: 4,4-二甲基-4-硅代戊磺酸钠提供了该次记录的核磁共振谱中的参照信号。

entries.en: The ES helped the technician identify the faulty component.
entries.zh: 专家系统帮助技术员找出了故障部件。

entries.en: The accountant reviewed AP before preparing the monthly balance sheet.
entries.zh: 会计在编制月度资产负债表之前审查了应付款。

entries.en: The chemist compared the GLC results for the two mixtures.
entries.zh: 化学家比较了对这两种混合物进行气液色谱分析所得的结果。

entries.en: The company issued CP to cover its temporary funding needs.
entries.zh: 该公司发行了商业本票，以满足临时资金需求。

entries.en: They expect the bridge repairs to last several yrs.
entries.zh: 他们预计桥梁维修要持续数年。

entries.en: Several emus stood beside the fence while the visitors passed.
entries.zh: 游客经过时，几只鸸鹋站在围栏旁。

entries.en: The NAM asked its members to comment on the draft proposal.
entries.zh: 美国全国制造商协会请会员就提案草案发表意见。

entries.en: The NCC received reports of an outage affecting several offices.
entries.zh: 网络控制中心收到了有关几处办公室断网的报告。

entries.en: The museum restored a VAX that had been stored for years.
entries.zh: 博物馆修复了一台已存放多年的 VAX 小型计算机。

entries.en: The parser removed CR from the end of each line.
entries.zh: 解析器删除了每行末尾的回车符。

entries.zh: 技术员在放大灯下检查了印制电路板。

entries.zh: 硬件升级后，那台服务器仍在运行 AIX 操作系统。

entries.zh: 她把一茶匙蜂蜜搅进了原味酸奶中。

entries.en: The koi gathered near the bridge as we approached the pond.
entries.zh: 我们走近池塘时，锦鲤聚到了桥边。

entries.zh: 她接上新设备时，即插即用功能识别到了它。

entries.zh: 面包师在温热的扁面包上撒了芝麻。

entries.en: The panel considered only one issue, viz. the cost of repairs.
entries.zh: 委员会只考虑了一个问题，即维修费用。

entries.en: The analysis detected Te in the rock, alongside several other elements.
entries.zh: 分析在岩石中检测到了碲及其他几种元素。

entries.zh: 学校从共用平板电脑上删除了不用的应用程序。

entries.zh: 这家人在当地一位精灵的神龛前留下了鲜花。

entries.zh: 一名岸上宪兵在港口大门处检查了他们的通行证。

entries.en: The JP checked the document before the visitor signed it.
entries.zh: 治安官在来访者签字前检查了文件。

entries.zh: 她把那封信的一份复写本放在了单独的文件夹里。
